def write_skill(path, frontmatter=True):
    path.mkdir(parents=True)
    if frontmatter:
        body = "---
name: %s
description: test skill
---
" % path.name
    else:
        body = "---
description: missing name
---
"
    (path / "SKILL.md").write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")

            root = Path(tmp)

            write_skill(root / "app" / ".agents" / "skills" / "grade", bom=True)
